name: quotahush-local
description: Shows Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, and Z.AI usage in the status bar through the QuotaHush local server.

enumDescriptions: Show Claude when QuotaHush detects a local Claude login.
Always show Claude, including authentication errors.
Hide Claude from the status bar and Usage view.
quotahush.providers.claude.description: Controls Claude quota tracking in the VS Code extension.

enumDescriptions: Show Codex when QuotaHush detects a local Codex login.
Always show Codex, including authentication errors.
Hide Codex from the status bar and Usage view.
quotahush.providers.codex.description: Controls Codex quota tracking in the VS Code extension.

enumDescriptions: Show DeepSeek when its API credentials are configured.
Always show DeepSeek, including configuration errors.
Hide DeepSeek from the status bar and Usage view.
quotahush.providers.deepseek.description: Controls DeepSeek quota tracking in the VS Code extension.

enumDescriptions: Show Z.AI when its API credentials are configured.
Always show Z.AI, including configuration errors.
Hide Z.AI from the status bar and Usage view.
quotahush.providers.zai.description: Controls Z.AI quota tracking in the VS Code extension.
